name: SSE streaming for LLM tokens and server push
short_definition: Server-Sent Events (SSE) are the default way to stream LLM tokens and one-way server push from FastAPI to browsers and BFF clients over HTTP. As of FastAPI 0.135+, use fastapi.sse.EventSourceResponse (built-in; current FastAPI 0.139.0). For advanced disconnect/shutdown control, sse-starlette 3.4.5 remains a strong alternative. Prefer SSE over WebSockets for token streams unless true bidirectional channel is required.
scope_in: LLM token streaming patterns (event types: token, error, done)
Client disconnect cancellation and resource cleanup
Auth on streaming endpoints and backpressure basics
scope_out: Provider-specific SDK deep dives (OpenAI/Anthropic) beyond stream consumption

defaults.alt: sse-starlette EventSourceResponse when you need explicit shutdown_event/send_timeout knobs
defaults.handler: async generator yield Pydantic models or ServerSentEvent; response_class=EventSourceResponse
defaults.events: token | error | done (raw_data='[DONE]' optional for OpenAI-like clients)
defaults.headers: Framework sets Cache-Control: no-cache and X-Accel-Buffering: no; keep-alive ping ~15s
defaults.method: POST for chat with body; GET for subscribe/feeds; EventSource browser API is GET-only so BFF/fetch often used for POST
defaults.cancel: On client disconnect, cancel upstream LLM task; don't continue billing after disconnect
defaults.auth: Depends before stream starts; don't stream secrets; re-check authZ for resource id
defaults.gzip: Avoid GZipMiddleware buffering SSE; exclude stream routes (py-middleware-stack)

use_sse_when: One-way progress, logs, notifications over HTTP
Browser or fetch clients that understand text/event-stream
use_websocket_when: Binary frames or custom multiplexed channels
use_json_lines_when: Non-browser pipelines that prefer NDJSON without SSE field framing
do_not: Don't use BackgroundTasks to 'stream' to nowhere
Don't buffer entire model response then fake stream
Don't apply response cache middleware to SSE routes

do: Yield small events frequently; send done/error terminal events
Propagate cancellation to provider streams (aclose / cancel task)
Set proxy read timeouts longer than max generation time
Include id on events if clients resume with Last-Event-ID
Rate limit and auth stream endpoints (cost control)
Structured events as JSON in data field via Pydantic
dont: Don't block event loop in generator (no sync SDK without to_thread)
Don't leave orphaned LLM requests after disconnect
Don't log full token streams with PII at info level
Don't compress/buffer SSE at nginx without X-Accel-Buffering off
Don't use WebSocket by default 'because AI demos did'
Don't ignore send failures (broken pipe) as success

code_skeleton:
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Header, HTTPException
from fastapi.sse import EventSourceResponse, ServerSentEvent
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

app = FastAPI()

class ChatIn(BaseModel):
    prompt: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=8000)

async def get_user() -> str:
    return "user_123"  # real JWT dep

CurrentUser = Annotated[str, Depends(get_user)]

async def llm_tokens(prompt: str) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
    # replace with provider stream; yield tokens
    for word in prompt.split():
        yield word + " "

@app.post("/v1/chat/stream", response_class=EventSourceResponse)
async def chat_stream(
    body: ChatIn,
    user: CurrentUser,
) -> AsyncIterator[ServerSentEvent]:
    try:
        async for token in llm_tokens(body.prompt):
            yield ServerSentEvent(data={"token": token, "user": user}, event="token")
        yield ServerSentEvent(raw_data="[DONE]", event="done")
    except Exception:
        yield ServerSentEvent(data={"message": "generation failed"}, event="error")
        raise

@app.get("/v1/feed", response_class=EventSourceResponse)
async def feed(
    last_event_id: Annotated[int | None, Header()] = None,
) -> AsyncIterator[ServerSentEvent]:
    start = (last_event_id or -1) + 1
    for i in range(start, start + 3):
        yield ServerSentEvent(data={"n": i}, id=str(i), event="tick")
failure_modes: Proxy buffers entire stream → client sees one dump at end
Worker killed by idle timeouts during long generation
Upstream LLM continues after client abort → cost leak
GZip/middleware consumes body and breaks event framing
Unhandled exception mid-stream without error event
Too-large events / unbounded prompt causing memory spikes
anti_patterns: Collect list of tokens then yield once
StreamingResponse with wrong content-type and hand-rolled half SSE
Auth only on a separate non-stream route
Infinite generator without disconnect checks (pre-built-in edge cases)
deprecation_watch: Only documenting sse-starlette while ignoring fastapi.sse for new FastAPI ≥0.135 apps
Fake streaming by returning full JSON
Long-polling as default for tokens when SSE available
ts_boundary: Browser UI often consumes streams via fetch to Next Route Handler which proxies to Python, or directly to Python with CORS. EventSource cannot set custom Authorization headers easily — prefer fetch streams for Bearer auth. Next RSC streaming is unrelated UI shell streaming; LLM tokens are API SSE. Type events in shared OpenAPI/event schema when generating clients.
rust_boundary: Rust can terminate SSE/proxy at the edge for ultra-high concurrency; Python remains ideal for LLM orchestration. Same event contract if dual implementation.
supabase_boundary: Don't stream through Postgres LISTEN as a substitute for LLM SSE without need. Persist final messages to Supabase after stream completes; optional Realtime for multi-tab UX separate from generation stream.
boundary_contracts: Event names: token|error|done (+ schema for data JSON)
Auth before first byte when possible
Idempotency/conversation id in request body for POST streams
Document max duration and disconnect cancel semantics

threats: Prompt injection reflected into other systems mid-stream
Token/PII leakage via verbose logging or shared caches
Cache poisoning if CDNs cache streams
mitigations: Sanitize logs; don't cache SSE at CDN

must_not_generate: WebSocket scaffold as default for simple token stream
Stream without any rate limit on public AI endpoints

error event or status on upstream failure
